# openmetadata_persona (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata persona. A persona represents a role a user assumes in the organisation and can carry a customised UI and a set of assigned users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_user" "alice" {
  name  = "alice"
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

resource "openmetadata_persona" "data_steward" {
  name         = "DataSteward"
  display_name = "Data Steward"
  description  = "Owns data quality and governance for the organisation."
  default      = true
  users        = [openmetadata_user.alice.fully_qualified_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Persona name. Changing it replaces the persona, because the name is also its fully qualified name.

### Optional

- `default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default persona for the organisation. The server defaults it to false.
- `description` (String) Markdown description of the persona.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.
- `users` (Set of String) Fully qualified names of the users assigned to this persona. When set it replaces the whole set; when omitted the server assigns none.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name. For a persona this equals name.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_persona.data_steward 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, which for a persona is its name.
terraform import openmetadata_persona.data_steward DataSteward
```
